<!-- ---- original lines 4691-5009 ---- -->

# CELL x GENES ANALYSIS
ED–M6 changes in immune cell fractions were modeled against within-participant expression changes restricted to the shared DEG set, allowing focused evaluation of cell–gene coupling within the core recovery-associated transcriptional program. This analysis tested whether dynamic shifts in circulating immune composition tracked with the transcriptional remodeling characteristic of recovery. Significant associations were identified through gene-level regressions and FDR correction, and overlap patterns were examined to characterize shared and cell type–specific relationships.

## Prep data 
Paired ED and M6 log₂ expression matrices are constructed by merging RNA-seq data with sample metadata, aligning participants by PID, and extracting the shared DEG set. Within-participant expression change (M6–ED) is then computed to generate the delta-expression matrix used in downstream analyses.
```{r}

metadata_RNA_paired <- metadata_RNA_paired  %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) 

# build paired ED/M6 log2 expression matrix for this analysis
RNA_log2_cells <- RNA_seq_log2 %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  right_join(
    metadata_RNA_paired %>%
      dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint),
    by = c("PID", "INVENTORY.CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("X")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint, dplyr::everything())

dim(RNA_log2_cells)  # 490 x 19907 

# ED log2 expression 
shared_ED_expr <- RNA_log2_cells %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "ED") %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(shared_DEGs_list))

# M6 log2 expression
shared_M6_expr <- RNA_log2_cells %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "M6") %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(shared_DEGs_list))

# ensure proper ED–M6 pairing by PID
shared_paired_pids <- intersect(shared_ED_expr$PID, shared_M6_expr$PID)

# arrange PIDs and make matrix 
shared_ED_mat <- shared_ED_expr %>%
  filter(PID %in% shared_paired_pids) %>%
  arrange(PID) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(shared_DEGs_list)) %>%
  as.matrix()

shared_M6_mat <- shared_M6_expr %>%
  filter(PID %in% shared_paired_pids) %>%
  arrange(PID) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(shared_DEGs_list)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# To align the direction of gene change with the CMap convention (treated–control), I defined log2 fold change as ED–M6. Thus, positive log2FC indicates higher expression during the acute trauma response (ED)
log2FC_matrix_shared <- shared_M6_mat - shared_ED_mat
rownames(log2FC_matrix_shared) <- sort(shared_paired_pids)
```

## CellType-Gene Intereactions 
Within-participant changes in immune cell fractions (M6–ED) are merged with delta-expression values for all shared DEGs. For each cell type, gene-level linear models (Δexpression ~ Δcell fraction) quantify the direction and significance of expression–cell relationships. FDR-adjusted results are summarized to identify the extent and magnitude of significant positive associations.
```{r}
## delta expression matrix  (M6-ED)
cells_delta_expr <- log2FC_matrix_shared %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(PID = sort(shared_paired_pids))

# cell columns names

cell_cols <- c("Neutrophils", "T.cells.CD8", "T.cells.CD4.naive", "NK.cells.resting", "B.cells.naive", "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.", "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", "Mast.cells.resting", "Monocytes", "NK.cells.activated", "B.cells.memory", "Macrophages.M2", "Plasma.cells", "Dendritic.cells.activated")

cell_labels <- c("Neutrophils", "CD8T cells", "Naive CD4T cells", "Resting NK cells", "Naive B cells", "Regulatory CD4T cells.", "Resting Memory CD4T cells", "Resting Mast cells", "Monocytes", "Activated NK cells", "Memory B cells", "M2 Macrophages", "Plasm .cells", "Activated Dendritic Cells")

cell_fractions_meta <- cell_fractions %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  inner_join(
    RNA_log2_cells %>% dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint),
    by = c("INVENTORY.CODE", "Timepoint", "PID")) %>%
  filter(PID %in% shared_paired_pids)

cell_fractions_ED <- cell_fractions_meta %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "ED") %>%
  arrange(PID) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cell_cols))

cell_fractions_M6 <- cell_fractions_meta %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "M6") %>%
  arrange(PID) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cell_cols))

# delta cell fractions (M6 – ED) 
delta_cell_fractions <- (cell_fractions_M6 - cell_fractions_ED) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(PID = sort(shared_paired_pids))

# prep matrices for regression
cells_delta_expr_mat <- cells_delta_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(-PID) %>%
  as.matrix()

delta_cell_fractions_tbl <- delta_cell_fractions %>%
  dplyr::select(-PID)

genes <- colnames(cells_delta_expr_mat)
celltypes <- colnames(delta_cell_fractions_tbl)

# gene ~ delta cell-fraction regressions 
results_list <- vector("list", length = length(celltypes))
names(results_list) <- celltypes

for (ct in celltypes) {
  ct_vec <- delta_cell_fractions_tbl[[ct]]
  
  fit_mat <- apply(
    cells_delta_expr_mat, 2,
    function(gene_vec) coef(summary(lm(gene_vec ~ ct_vec)))[2, ])
  
  df <- as.data.frame(t(fit_mat))
  df$Gene <- genes
  df$CellType <- ct
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- df
}

cell_gene_associations <- bind_rows(results_list)

colnames(cell_gene_associations)[1:4] <- c("Estimate", "Std.Error", "t.value", "Pvalue")

cell_gene_associations_df <- cell_gene_associations %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(CellType, Gene, everything())

out_dir <- "Cell x DEG Analysis/Results per Cell Type"

# helper to make safe filenames
safe_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+$", "")
}

cell_gene_associations_df %>%
  group_split(CellType) %>%
  walk(function(df_cell) {

    cell <- df_cell$CellType[[1]]
    file_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("CellxGeneAssociations_", safe_name(cell), ".csv"))

    df_cell %>%
      arrange(FDR, Pvalue) %>%
      write_csv(file_out)
  })


# Per-cell-type significance summaries 
sig_cell_gene_associations <- cell_gene_associations_df %>%
    mutate(direction = case_when(
      Estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",
      Estimate < 0 ~ "Negative")) %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.01) %>%
  count(CellType, direction, name = "n_sig_genes") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = direction,
    values_from = n_sig_genes,
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Positive + Negative) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
  

#write.csv(sig_cell_gene_associations, "Cell x DEG Analysis/Summaries/Cell x DEG Significant Counts.csv")



# filter to positively significant cell x gene interactions 
# focus on the how gene changes associated with cell types changes 
positive_cell_gene_associations_df <- cell_gene_associations_df %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.01, Estimate > 0) %>%    
  dplyr::select(CellType, Gene)

positive_cell_gene_associations_counts <- positive_cell_gene_associations_df %>%
  count(CellType, name = "n_sig_genes") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_genes))

```

## Export
```{r}
# list csv files
csv_files <- list.files("Cell x DEG Analysis/Results per Cell Type", full.names = TRUE)

# helper to recover cell name from filename
get_cell_name <- function(path) {
  path %>%
    basename() %>%
    str_remove("^CellxGeneAssociations_") %>%
    str_remove("\\.csv$") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    substr(1, 31)
}

# create workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

for (f in csv_files) {

  df <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(FDR, Pvalue) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num))

  sheet_name <- get_cell_name(f)

  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df, withFilter = FALSE)

  header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")

  body_style <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE)

  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, body_style, rows = 2:(nrow(df) + 1), cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE)

  setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df), widths = "auto")
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "Cell x DEG Analysis/Summaries/All Cell x Gene Associations.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)



```

## UpSet plot
Significant positive gene–cell associations (FDR < 0.01) are converted into a binary gene-by-cell matrix and visualized using an UpSet diagram. The plot highlights overlap patterns across immune populations, illustrating shared and cell type–specific sets of positively associated genes.
```{r upset-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

upset_input <- positive_cell_gene_associations_df %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = CellType,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -Dendritic.cells.activated,
    -Macrophages.M2,
    -NK.cells.resting
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    "CD8T cells" = T.cells.CD8,
    "Naive CD4T cells" = T.cells.CD4.naive,
    "Naive B cells" = B.cells.naive,
    "Regulatory CD4T cells" = T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.,
    "Resting Memory CD4T cells" = T.cells.CD4.memory.resting,
    "Resting Mast cells" = Mast.cells.resting,
    "Activated NK cells" = NK.cells.activated,
    "Memory B cells" = B.cells.memory,
    "Plasma cells" = Plasma.cells
  )

upset_df <- upset_input %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene")

upset_df[] <- lapply(upset_df, as.integer)

set_order <- colnames(upset_df)  

par(col = "black", fg = "black")

plot_upset <- function(upset_df) {
  set_order <- rev(colnames(upset_df))
  UpSetR::upset(
    upset_df,
    sets = set_order,
    keep.order = TRUE,
    nsets = length(set_order),
    nintersects = 10,
    order.by = "freq",
    decreasing = TRUE,
    mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
    set_size.show = FALSE,
    sets.bar.color = "#2A93B5",
    main.bar.color = "#2A93B5",
    matrix.color = "black",
    matrix.dot.alpha = 0.8,
    point.size = 3,
    line.size = 0.2,
    text.scale = c(1.75, 1.75, 1.25, 1.5, 1.5 , 0),
    mainbar.y.label = "# of Shared DEGs",
    sets.x.label = "# Associated DEGs per\nCell Type (FDR < 0.01)")
}

# 1 y-axis label 
# 2 y-axis text
# 3 left bar plot axis title 
# 4 left bar plot axis text 
# 5 = cell names 
# 6 = bar numbers 

plot_upset(upset_df)

jpeg(filename = "Figures/Ext Data Fig 3 - Cell x Gene Upset Plot.jpg", width  = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
plot_upset(upset_df)
dev.off()
```
